What you get  A salary between €68,000-75,000 including holiday allowance, based on your experience.  €5,000 a year for your own growth, with a real say in how you spend it.  25 vacation days + the option to buy up to 10 more + local public holidays + the option of a sabbatical up to 4 months.  Two trips abroad a year with the whole team + occasional drinks and team outings.  €500 home-office budget and a great laptop.  A well-earned "Hey, well done Buddy!", now and then.  Hybrid preferred, with 1-2 days per week in our Rotterdam office. We live for the WOW moment, that sparkle in users' eyes when they gain new insights and discover opportunities.    What the job looks like  Get under the skin of each container terminal. Walk through its systems and processes with the people who run its day-to-day operations, from maintenance and container vessel operations to the edge-case manual adjustments everyone secretly relies on. Understand how things really work and how operational activities are recorded in their systems. Turn local chaos into a standard set of requirements and data definitions. Help the teams at each terminal understand how their local data contributes to global insights, and translate what you agree with them into concrete requirements for the data engineering team. Own whether the numbers are right. Reconcile our figures with the terminal's own reports, validate them together with the relevant teams, and get problems fixed at their source. Work closely with data engineers and terminal teams towards the same goal. Challenge logic early, explain what a number means (and what it doesn't), and make sure the data reflects reality. The data engineers own the build; you own making sure the result reflects what actually happens at the terminal. Build relationships across the globe. Every week, you'll speak with people from several container terminals across different continents, each with their own processes, systems and history. Expect to be asked how you think new tools could impact the way we work, because for us, they already do. Delivery: You're experienced in delivering work within agreed timelines, proactively resolving challenges and taking the initiative to find answers. Experience with tools like Azure DevOps, Jira or Linear is a plus. Language: You communicate clearly and confidently in English, including with operational teams where English is often a second language. Other languages are a plus. Data & Statistics: Help design our HTS test database, with traceability from supplier and reel through to cable, and turn results into statistical datasets for magnet modelling and design. R&D HTS Qualification: Run tape and cable qualification test campaigns, both in-house and at external facilities. Technician Guidance: Write procedures and guide the technicians who run routine tests. Safety: Ensure safe work with cryogens, high currents and high magnetic fields.
